newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close higher on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Tuesday's settlement day on short-covering, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.
The 100-share index ended 7.97 points, or 0.52 percent, up at 1,534.89 amid 172 losers and 59 gainers in a provisional turnover of 34 million shares compared to Monday's 41 million.
Short-covering in speculative stocks pushed the index into the positive zone, one dealer said. "Stock prices are likely to open higher on the new accounts day on Wednesday," he said.
